notes: New M3 error codes (gameplay.md §8.1) with class and destination, plus the additive reason strings on accepted codes. Run-command failures are runtime codes, not commands.md §5.4 rows.

game_command_invalid.raisedWhen: a run command is rejected for the current run state or conflicts with a pending command

game_spawn_invalid.raisedWhen: the reset destination does not resolve, is outside content.game.level, or is at/below killY (fail-stop)

game_spawn_blocked.raisedWhen: the clearance/overlap probe rejects the destination (fail-stop, no retry, no fallback)

camera_viewport_invalid.raisedWhen: setViewport receives a non-finite, non-positive or oversized dimension

game_session_unavailable.raisedWhen: a run/view/viewport call on a runtime that is not M3-enabled

notAdded: commands.md §5.4 gains no row: run-command failures are runtime codes, not authoring-command failures.
